mapper.select: select id, case_id, member_id, queue_ref, diagnosis_category, priority, state, state_version, assignee_ref, public_status, customer_information_type, customer_information, last_public_message, updated_at from ai_service_case where state = 'QUEUED' or assignee_ref = #{username} order by case when state = 'QUEUED' then 0 else 1 end, updated_at desc, id desc limit #{limit}

select id, case_id, member_id, queue_ref, diagnosis_category, priority, state, state_version, assignee_ref, public_status, customer_information_type, customer_information, last_public_message, updated_at from ai_service_case where case_id = #{caseId} limit 1
mapper.update: update ai_service_case set state='CLAIMED', state_version=state_version+1, assignee_ref=#{processor}, public_status=#{publicStatus}, last_public_message=#{publicMessage}, updated_at=now() where case_id=#{caseId} and state='QUEUED' and assignee_ref is null and state_version=#{expectedVersion}
mapper.insert: insert into ai_service_case_action ( action_id, case_id, actor_kind, actor_ref, action_type, expected_version, result_code, public_message, internal_note, idempotency_key, correlation_ref, created_at ) values ( #{actionId}, #{caseId}, 'processor', #{actorRef}, #{actionType}, #{expectedVersion}, #{resultCode}, #{publicMessage}, #{internalNote}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{correlationRef}, now() )

insert into ai_service_case_outbox ( event_id, case_id, member_id, event_type, state_version, correlation_ref, status, attempt_count, available_at, lease_until, published_at, last_error, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{eventId}, #{caseId}, #{memberId}, #{eventType}, #{stateVersion}, #{correlationRef}, 'PENDING', 0, null, null, null, null, now(), now() )
